---
title: "Appendix A2 - South-west Corner Marine Park (Western arm) Natural Values Report"
subtitle: "South-west Marine Parks Network"
filters:
  - figure-numbering.lua
format:
  pdf:
    output-file: "Project 4.21-SWC-western-arm-2-Appendix A2-q-Natural values.pdf"
    fig-pos: 'H'
    geometry: 
      - top=2cm
      - bottom=2.5cm
      - left=2cm
      - right=2cm
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        \usepackage{caption}
        \usepackage{float}
        \usepackage{chngcntr}
        \floatplacement{table}{H}
        \newcounter{metric}
        \counterwithin*{figure}{metric}
        \captionsetup{format=plain, indention=0pt}
        % Appendix prefix. Change A2 here and in figure-numbering.lua together.
        \renewcommand{\thefigure}{A2.\arabic{figure}}
        \renewcommand{\thetable}{A2.\arabic{table}}
  html:
    output-file: "Project 4.21-SWC-western-arm-2-Appendix A2-q-Natural values.html"
    fig-dpi: 96
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        <style>
          caption,
          .gt_caption,
          .table-caption,
          figcaption,
          .figure-caption,
          .quarto-float-caption,
          .quarto-float-caption-top,
          .quarto-float-tbl figcaption {
            text-align: justify !important;
            text-justify: inter-word;
            hyphens: auto;
          }
        </style>
    include-after-body:
      text: |
        <script>
        // Figures are prefixed by figure-numbering.lua. Quarto builds the table
        // caption after that filter runs, so the table prefix is applied here.
        // TODO Keep "A2" in step with fig_prefix in figure-numbering.lua.
        document.querySelectorAll("caption, .gt_caption, .table-caption, figcaption")
          .forEach(function (el) {
            // el.innerHTML re-serialises a non-breaking space as the literal
            // "&nbsp;" entity text, not a whitespace character, so \s alone
            // does not match it - match either form here.
            el.innerHTML = el.innerHTML.replace(/^(\s*Table(?:\s|&nbsp;)+)(\d+)/, "$1A2.$2");
          });
        </script>
toc: true
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
post-render: 10_move-pdf.R

```{r}
#| include: false
library(here)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(terra)
library(tidyterra)
library(cowplot)
library(png)
library(grid)
library(tidytext)
library(ggtext)
library(dplyr)
library(gt)

# Park folder and file prefix - must match 00_config.yml.
park <- "swc_westernarm_npz05"
name <- "swc_westernarm_npz05"
```

# Natural Values

Understanding of natural values

{{< pagebreak >}}

## Sampling summary

```{r}
#| label: tbl-sampling-effort
#| tbl-cap: "Summary of monitoring campaigns in the study area, showing the survey dates, sampling method, management zones sampled, and the number of samples with each data type. NPZ = National Park Zone, HPZ = Habitat Protection Zone, MUZ = Multiple Use Zone, SPZ = Special Purpose Zone."

# LaTeX will not break a line at an underscore, so a long campaign ID would run
# past its column. Swapping underscores for spaces lets the name wrap.
sampling_summary <- readRDS(here("data", park, "tidy",
                                 paste0(name, "_sampling-summary.RDS"))) %>%
  mutate(campaignid = gsub("_", " ", campaignid))

col_labels <- c("Date", "Campaign name", "Method", "Areas", "Samples",
                "Count", "Count", "Length")

sampling_summary %>%
  gt() %>%
  cols_label(dates         = col_labels[1],
             campaignid    = col_labels[2],
             method        = col_labels[3],
             areas         = col_labels[4],
             n_samples     = col_labels[5],
             habitat_count = col_labels[6],
             fish_count    = col_labels[7],
             fish_length   = col_labels[8]) %>%
  tab_spanner(label = "Habitat", columns = habitat_count) %>%
  tab_spanner(label = "Fish",    columns = c(fish_count, fish_length)) %>%
  sub_zero(zero_text = "-") %>%
  cols_width(dates         ~ pct(14),
             campaignid    ~ pct(20),
             method        ~ pct(11),
             areas         ~ pct(15),
             n_samples     ~ pct(10),
             habitat_count ~ pct(10),
             fish_count    ~ pct(10),
             fish_length   ~ pct(10)) %>%
  cols_align(align = "left",
             columns = c(dates, campaignid, areas)) %>%
  cols_align(align = "center",
             columns = c(method, n_samples, habitat_count, fish_count,
                         fish_length)) %>%
  opt_row_striping() %>%
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
            locations = list(cells_column_labels(),
                             cells_column_spanners(spanners = everything()))) %>%
  tab_options(table.width               = pct(100),
              table.font.size           = px(11),
              data_row.padding          = px(4),
              latex.use_longtable       = TRUE,
              column_labels.border.top.style = "none",
              table.border.top.style    = "none",
              table_body.hlines.style   = "none")
```

{{< pagebreak >}}

## Benthic ecosystem extent
### Observations

```{r}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 4
#| fig-cap: "Habitat classes observed in spatially balanced stereo-BRUV and drop-camera imagery visualised as spatial pie charts. Commonwealth marine park boundaries are shown. The red line delimits state and commonwealth waters. Bathymetric contour at 30 m is shown."
img <- png::readPNG(here("plots", park, "habitat",
                         paste0(name, "_scatterpie_2020-2021-2024-2025.png")))
grid::grid.raster(img)
```

{{< pagebreak >}}

### Dominant habitat types

```{r}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5
#| fig-cap: "Predicted dominant habitat type by year from stereo-BRUV groundtruthing. Commonwealth marine park boundaries are shown. The red line delimits state and commonwealth waters. Bathymetric contour at 30 m is shown."
p_cat <- readRDS(here("plots", park, "habitat",
                      paste0(name, "_predicted-habitat-categorical_2020-2021-2024-2025.rds")))
p_cat
```

{{< pagebreak >}}

### Habitat distribution and probability

```{r}
#| fig-width: 6.5
#| fig-height: 7
#| fig-cap: "Predicted habitat distribution probability and uncertainty by year from stereo-BRUV groundtruthing. Commonwealth marine park boundaries are shown. The red line delimits state and commonwealth waters. Bathymetric contour at 30 m is shown."
p_dom <- readRDS(here("plots", park, "habitat",
                      paste0(name, "_predicted-dominant-habitat_2020-2021-2024-2025.rds")))
p_dom
```

{{< pagebreak >}}

### Funcional reef distribution and probability

```{r}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 9
#| fig-cap: "Predicted reef distribution probability and uncertainty from stereo-BRUV groundtruthing. Commonwealth marine park boundaries are shown. The red line delimits state and commonwealth waters. Bathymetric contour at 30 m is shown."
img_path <- here("plots", park, "habitat",
                 paste0(name, "_predicted-reef-and-se_2020-2021-2024-2025.png"))
img <- png::readPNG(img_path)
grid::grid.raster(img)
```

## Benchmarks of benthic natural values

```{=latex}
% Continue the running figure number into the benchmark sections, then switch
% to <metric>.<plot> numbering. `metric` is seeded to the last benthic-extent
% figure number so the majors carry on sequentially from wherever the extent
% figures finished.
\setcounter{metric}{\value{figure}}
\renewcommand{\thefigure}{A2.\arabic{metric}.\arabic{figure}}
```

### Sand

```{=latex}
\stepcounter{metric}
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 2
#| fig-cap: "Sand: benchmark plots by zone and depth contour from stereo-BRUV groundtruthing. SWCMP = South-west Corner Marine Park (Commonwealth), NCMP = Ngari Capes Marine Park (State)."

                          paste0(name, "_control-plot_sand.rds")))
p_control
```
